targets.rawSql: SELECT t.ts AS time, s.name AS metric, t.value_num AS value FROM telemetry t JOIN satellite s USING (norad) WHERE t.field = 'battery_v' ORDER BY t.ts

panels.title: Frames received per hour, by satellite

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', t.ts) AS time, s.name AS metric, count(DISTINCT t.ts)::float AS value FROM telemetry t JOIN satellite s USING (norad) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Link status — last frame, coverage, battery

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name AS satellite, s.norad, max(t.ts) AS last_frame, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - max(t.ts)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_silent, count(DISTINCT t.ts) AS frames_7d, round(avg(t.value_num) FILTER (WHERE t.field = 'battery_v')::numeric, 2) AS avg_battery_v, round(avg(t.value_num) FILTER (WHERE t.field = 'battery_pct')::numeric, 0) AS avg_battery_pct FROM satellite s LEFT JOIN telemetry t USING (norad) GROUP BY s.name, s.norad ORDER BY max(t.ts) DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Imaging: capture to publication, by constellation (open Planet disaster releases)
panels.description: Hours between a scene's capture and its public release, per day and constellation. Metadata from Planet's open Crisis Response STAC catalog (imagery CC-BY-NC-4.0). Empty until the first daily walk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', captured) AS time, constellation AS metric, avg(extract(epoch FROM published - captured) / 3600) AS value FROM scene WHERE published IS NOT NULL AND captured > now() - interval '2 years' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Imaging events: scenes, satellites, first and last capture

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.title AS event, count(s.id) AS scenes, count(DISTINCT s.norad) AS satellites, min(s.captured) AS first_capture, max(s.captured) AS last_capture, round(avg(extract(epoch FROM s.published - s.captured) / 3600)::numeric, 1) AS avg_lag_h FROM event e LEFT JOIN scene s ON s.event = e.slug GROUP BY e.slug, e.title ORDER BY max(s.captured) DESC NULLS LAST

target.rawSql: SELECT started AS time, coalesce(ended, now()) AS timeend, coalesce(note, 'No answer from the ' || source || ' API: the control room ran on stale data' || CASE WHEN ended IS NULL THEN ' (ongoing)' ELSE '' END) AS text, 'upstream-cut' AS tags FROM provider_outage WHERE started <= $__timeTo() AND coalesce(ended, now()) >= $__timeFrom() ORDER BY started
